answer: Make each seat pay in wall-clock time. Every epoch a seat posts a verifiable delay proof: a chain of squarings seeded by its address and the fresh beacon, one squaring kernel running about twenty minutes on a single core. It can't be done early or sped up with parallel chips, yet checks in milliseconds. Pay per seat is capped near that core's cost, so a farm spreading like yarrow must rent a busy core for every patch and nets almost nothing. Proofs show as violet dots in the explorer, so lapsed seats stand out.
